camera.title: Camera Access Needed
camera.message: To take photos or record video, this app needs access to your camera.
camera.blockedMessage: Camera access is turned off for this app. You can turn it on in your device settings.

videoRecording.title: Camera and Microphone Access Needed
videoRecording.message: Recording video needs access to your camera and microphone.
videoRecording.blockedMessage: Camera or microphone access is turned off for this app. You can turn it on in your device settings.

microphone.title: Microphone Access Needed
microphone.message: Voice memos need microphone access. You can enable it in your device settings.

location.title: Location Access Needed
location.message: This feature needs location access. You can enable it in your device settings.
